args.summary: Following the deployment of v2.3.1, checkout-api failed health checks in production. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified: service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after health check failures on v2.3.1

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Investigated**: `list_deployments` showed the latest production release v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (the prior production release) had been healthy.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback was executed and verified — the service is now healthy in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the health check failures on v2.3.1, the rollback to v2.3.0 in all regions, and the verified recovery. On-call has been paged.
